provider: lz.qaiu.top, the keyless multi-pan direct-link resolver

free_tier.stated: No quota of its own: it converts a share link into a direct download URL, and the quota is whatever the upstream share holds. It matters because it is the only route found that turns a Chinese share link into a fetchable URL with no account, no cookie and no API key

retention.stated: Not applicable. Signed redirects carry X-Amz-Expires=86400 and are cached about eight hours, so a URL is resolved per session rather than stored

egress.terms: Free. It issues a 302 to the real CDN origin, so the bytes never traverse the resolver: verified against China Mobile EOS with X-Amz-Expires=86400

tooling: two public keyless forms, GET https://lz.qaiu.top/parser?url=<enc>&pwd=<pin> which 302s, or the short form https://lz.qaiu.top/ec/<key>@<pin>. A mirror at lz0.qaiu.top. Self-hostable from the repository with Docker on ports 6400 and 6401
chaining: Pair with a public AList that lists share links, or with any resource site, to fetch Chinese-pan content without an account. The self-hosted build is the real win: run it on any VPS and the public instance's rate limits stop mattering

limits.value: it resolves and does not store: there is no write path at all
the public instance is rate-limited and the author warns 请不要过度依赖 lz.qaiu.top

identity_cost.detail: no account, no key and no cookie for the free drivers. The professional endpoint needs an X-API-Key

reliability_note: Alive and actively maintained, Trendshift-listed. A community-run free instance can be throttled or blocked by pan vendors at any moment and the README says so, so self-hosting is what makes it load-bearing

evidence.proved: HTTP 302 with a location on eos-huhehaote-1.cmecloud.cn carrying X-Amz-Expires=86400, Server nginx

evidence.url: probe:China Mobile EOS redirect target, Range 0-524287
evidence.proved: 206 with 524,288 bytes, the file identified as ISO Media MP4, Server ChinaMobileEOS, so the redirect delivered real bytes
401 '未提供API Key', so the professional tier is keyed as documented
500 '暂未实现', so Baidu is not in the free tier
the supported-pan table and the free versus professional split

binding_note: The resolver is free, keyless and fast, and it stores nothing, so what binds is that it only resolves: there is no write path, and the pans a client would most want are behind the keyed endpoint.
notes: The single highest-leverage piece of glue in the topic and the reason the pan survey is usable at all. Two endpoints, and the split is the finding: the free one covers lanzou, ilanzou, ctfile, wenshushu, feijipan and ecpan, and the keyed one adds Baidu, Xunlei, Quark, UC, 139, 189 and Unicom.
